issues.on_page: Interest expense: Water 13,862, Sewer (16,336), Total (2,474); Loan and bond fees (37,261); p8 cash flows: interest paid (30,198), fees paid (9,537)
issues.issue: The report's own interest/fee split is wrong, not just a sign error. Per the cash flow statement, Water's interest was (13,862) and its fees (937). On p7 the 13,862 is printed as positive and Water's fees (28,661) are overstated by 27,724 (= 2 x 13,862). Corrected figures are interest 30,198 and fees 9,537. The combined 39,735 (2,474 + 37,261, disbursements[18]+[19]) is right, and both lines are debt service interest, so category totals are unaffected. The JSON note calls this a 'likely sign error'.

The department columns on p11 give the function exactly: Fire is public safety and Ballpark/Community Center are environment and leisure (they reconcile to p5: public safety 68,232 = Police 34,958 + Fire operating 33,003 + Rescue 271; environment and leisure 20,799 = Ballpark 17,057 + Community Center 3,742). Putting the whole Total column under general government makes detail general government 134,861 against 80,688 on p5, public safety 34,858 against 68,232, and culture/recreation 0 against 20,799.
